products.name: Chicken Curry Cut
products.description: Fresh tender chicken cut into perfect curry pieces (12-14 pcs/kg). Cleaned, skinless, ideal for homestyle chicken curry.

products.name: Chicken Boneless
products.description: 100% tender, lean boneless chicken breast fillets. Cleaned, perfectly trimmed of fat. High in protein, great for grilling or butter chicken.

products.name: Chicken Drumsticks
products.description: Juicy, succulent whole chicken drumsticks (tangdi). Cleaned and skinless. Ideal for tandoori, deep frying, or rich gravy.

products.name: Chicken Keema
products.description: Freshly ground fresh chicken keema made from tender boneless breast meat. Smooth texture, perfect for chicken kebabs, keema paratha, or burgers.

products.name: Chicken Liver and Gizzard
products.description: Nutrient-rich, fresh chicken liver (kaleji) and gizzard (pota). Cleaned, washed, and portioned fresh per order.

products.name: Mutton Curry Cut
products.description: Prime cuts of bone-in fresh goat meat (shoulder, rib, leg pieces). Cleaned and cut into even curry-sized chunks.

products.name: Mutton Boneless
products.description: Clean boneless goat meat chunks with zero bone. Cut from the leg and shoulder. Perfect for kebabs, tikka, or rich stews.

products.name: Mutton Keema
products.description: Freshly minced prime boneless goat meat. Smooth, fine texture, ideal for shami kebabs, keema matar, and samosas.

products.name: Mutton Kaleji (Liver)
products.description: Fresh whole goat liver (kaleji) cleaned and portioned. Tender, rich in iron and nutrients, perfect for spicy kaleji masala.

products.name: Mutton Paya
products.description: Freshly singed, cleaned, and descaled goat trotters (4 pieces). Packed with natural collagen and gelatin for rich, nourishing paya soup.

products.name: Rohu & Catla Curry Cut (With Head)

products.name: Rohu & Catla Curry Cut (Without Head)

products.name: Fish Boneless
